identificationModule.briefTitle: Efficacy and Safety of a New Chewable Versus the Swallowable Tablet of Mebendazole Against Hookworm
identificationModule.officialTitle: Efficacy and Safety of a New Chewable Tablet of Mebendazole Versus the Swallowable, Standard Tablet of Mebendazole Against Hookworm Infections in Children: a Randomized Controlled Trial

collaborators.name: Public Health Laboratory Ivo de Carneri

descriptionModule.briefSummary: The rational of this study is to provide evidence on the safety and efficacy of a new chewable tablet of mebendazole compared to the standard tablet in preschool- and school-aged children infected with hookworm.

armGroups.label: Chewable tablet of mebendazole
armGroups.description:
* 3-5 year olds allocated to the swallowable tablet arm will be given the crushed tablet on a spoon mixed with a small amount of clean water;
* 6-12 year olds allocated to the swallowable tablet arm will be given the whole tablet to swallow with a glass of clean water;

armGroups.label: Swallowable tablet of mebendazole
armGroups.description:
* 3-5 year olds allocated to the chewable tablet arm will be encouraged to chew the tablet and swallow it without water; if they cannot chew it then a small amount of water will be added to the tablet in a spoon;
* 6-12 year olds allocated to the chewable tablet arm will be encouraged to chew the tablet and then swallow it without water.

interventions.name: Mebendazole
interventions.description: Treatment with one of the two formulations of mebendazole. The only difference between both arms is the type of formulation of the drug: chewable versus swallowable tablet.

primaryOutcomes.measure: Geometric Mean Egg Reduction Rate (ERR) of the Two Formulations of Mebendazole Against Hookworm
primaryOutcomes.description: Eggs per gram of stool (EPG) will be assessed by adding up the egg counts from the quadruplicate Kato-Katz thick smears and multiplying this number by a factor of six. The egg reduction rate (ERR) is calculated as follows: ERR = (1-(geometric mean EPG at follow-up/geometric mean EPG at baseline))\*100). Note: in contrast to the publication the "outcome measure" entry mask requires the complementary percentage: (geometric mean at follow-up/geometric mean at baseline)\*100).
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Baseline (before treatment) and sometime between 14 and 21 days post-treatment

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Cure Rate (CR) of Mebendazole Against Hookworm
secondaryOutcomes.description: Cure rates (CRs) will be calculated as the percentage of egg-positive participants at baseline who become egg-negative after treatment.
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Baseline (before treatment) and sometime between 14 and 21 days post-treatment
